Rashi on Ketubot 52b:10:1.hebrew: דרחמנא אמר ברא לירות - דכתיב (במדבר כ״ז:ח׳), איש כי ימות ובן אין לו וגו' — הא יש לו, בנו יורשו ולא בתו:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:10:1.english: That the Merciful One says [that] the son inherits - As it is written (Numbers 27:8): "If a man dies and has no son, etc." — [thus,] if he has [a son], his son inherits him, and not his daughter.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:10:2.english: And they enacted that the daughter should inherit - That the father should give her his property, which his sons were fit to inherit.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:11:1.hebrew: בשלמא בנו בידו - לבקש לו אשה, שדרכו של איש לחזר על אשה:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:11:1.english: Granted, his son is in his hand - To seek a wife for him, for it is the manner of a man to court a woman.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:11:2.english: But his daughter, is [she] in his hand? - Is it the way of a woman to court a man?

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:13:1.hebrew: ואימא דאב לירות דבעל לא לירות - כיון דטעמא כדי שיקפוץ ליתן לבתו הוא דתקון, נדוניא דיהב אב לבתו לירתון בנים דילה, אבל שאר כתובות נכסי הבעל, כגון מנה מאתים ותוספת דבעל, לא לירתון:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:13:1.english: But say that what is of the father they should inherit, [and] what is of the husband they should not inherit - Since the reason they instituted [this] is so that [the father] will leap [eagerly] to give to his daughter, the dowry that the father gives to his daughter, her sons should inherit; however, the rest of the ketubah [obligations from] the husband's property — such as the maneh, the two hundred [zuz], and the husband's additional [jointure] — they should not inherit.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:13:2.english: If so - that they do not inherit the rest of the ketubah.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:13:3.hebrew: אב נמי מימנע ולא כתב - לבתו, "אחרי שזה מקפיד על שלו מלהוריש לבני בתי, אף אני אמשוך ידי מלהרבות לו נדוניא":
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:13:3.english: [The] father will also refrain from writing - for his daughter, [saying:] "Since this [husband] is particular about his own [property] not to bequeath [it] to my daughter's sons, I too will withhold my hand from increasing [a] dowry for him."

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:14:1.hebrew: היכא דכתב אב כו' - כיון דטעמא משום שיקפוץ אב לתת נדוניא לבתו היא, היכא דכתב אב נדוניא לבתו — נכתוב בעל תנאי כתובת בנין דכרין; והיכא דלא כתב אב נדוניא לבתו — לא נכתוב בעל תנאי כתובת בנין דכרין:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:14:1.english: Where [the] father wrote, etc. - Since the reason [for the enactment] is so that a father will eagerly give a dowry to his daughter, where a father wrote a dowry for his daughter, let the husband write the stipulation of the ketubah of male children; and where a father did not write a dowry for his daughter, let the husband not write the stipulation of the ketubah of male children.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:14:2.hebrew: לא פלוג רבנן - לא חלקו בין כתובה לכתובה. אחרי שרוב כתובות יש בהן נדוניא, לא חלקו:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:14:2.english: The Sages did not distinguish - They did not distinguish between one ketubah and another. Since most ketubot have a dowry, they did not distinguish.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:15:1.hebrew: בת בין הבנים תירות - [כיון דטעמא משום נדוניא הוא, היכא דאין לו בנים ממנה אלא] יש לו בת מן אשה אחת ובנים מן האחרת, תטול בת היחידה כתובת אמה לירש נדוניא שנתן אבי אמה. מאי שנא דתקון בנין דכרין:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:15:1.english: A daughter among the sons should inherit - [Since the reason is because of the dowry, where he has no sons from her, rather] he has a daughter from one wife and sons from the other — let the only daughter take her mother's ketubah to inherit the dowry that her mother's father gave! Why did they enact [it only for] male children?

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:15:2.hebrew: כנחלה שויוה רבנן - דירתון תנן, ואין בת יורשת בין הבנים:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:15:2.english: The Sages made it like an inheritance - For we learned [in the Mishnah the term] yirtun ("they shall inherit"), and a daughter does not inherit among the sons.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:16:1.hebrew: בת בין הבנות תירות - יש לו בת מן אשה אחת ובנות מן האחרת, תטול בת היחידה כתובת אמה לירש נדוניית אבי אמה, דהא א"נ שויוה כנחלה, יש משפט נחלה לבת בין הבנות:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:16:1.english: A daughter among the daughters should inherit - [If] he has a daughter from one wife and daughters from the other [wife], the single daughter should take her mother's ketubah, to inherit her maternal grandfather's dowry; for even if they made it like an inheritance, a daughter among daughters has the right of inheritance.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:16:2.hebrew: לא פלוג רבנן - במשפט כתובת בנין דכרין, דבת בין הבנים לא תשקול ובת בין הבנות תשקול:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:16:2.english: The Sages did not distinguish - in the law of the marriage contract [clause concerning] male children, [to rule] that a daughter among sons should not take [it] and a daughter among daughters should take [it].

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:16:3.hebrew: ותגבי ממטלטלי - כיון דטעמא משום נדוניית אבי האם הוא, אלמה אמרינן לעיל (כתובות דף נ:) "כשם שאין הבנים יורשין אלא מקרקע", ואוקימנא בכתובת בנין דכרין:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:16:3.english: And let it be collected from movable property - Since the reason [for the enactment] is because of the dowry of the mother's father, why did we say earlier (Ketubot 50b), "Just as the sons inherit only from land," and we established it [as referring] to the ketubah of male children?

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:16:4.english: The Sages made it like a ketubah - and the movable property of orphans is not encumbered by a document.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:17:1.hebrew: תטרוף ממשעבדי - אי ככתובה שויוה, ולקמן פליגי בה בריש פרק אע"פ:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:17:1.english: Let it be collected from liened [property] - If they treated it like a ketubah; and later they dispute this at the beginning of Chapter Af Al Pi.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:17:2.english: We learned: "Will inherit" - And there is no inheritance in liened [property].

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:17:3.hebrew: ואימא אע"ג דליכא מותר דינר - יתר על שתי הכתובות, יטלו כתובת אמם כדין כתובת בנין דכרין. אלמה תנן בפרק מי שהיה נשוי (לקמן כתובות צא.): אין שם אלא שתי כתובות, חולקין בשוה:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:17:3.english: And say [that] even though there is no surplus of a dinar - beyond the two ketubot, they should take their mother's ketubah according to the law of the ketubah of male children. Why, then, did we learn in chapter Mi Shehayah Nasui (below, Ketubot 91a): "[If] there is only [enough for] the two ketubot there, they divide [the estate] equally"?

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:17:4.english: [In a] case where inheritance by Torah [law] is uprooted - on account of a rabbinic inheritance.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:17:5.hebrew: לא תקון רבנן - נחלה דידהו לעקור נחלת חלוקה שוה לגמרי, שהיא מן התורה. הלכך, כי איכא מותר דינר שיחלקוהו בשוה בנחלה דאורייתא — יטלו אלו כתובת אמן ואלו כתובת אמן משום נחלה דרבנן, ואי לא — לא:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:17:5.english: The Sages did not enact - their [rabbinic] inheritance [so as] to completely uproot the inheritance of equal division, which is by Torah law. Therefore, when there is a surplus of a dinar that they will divide equally as a Torah-law inheritance — these [sons] take their mother's ketubah and those [sons] take their mother's ketubah by virtue of the rabbinic inheritance, and if not, [they do] not.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:18:1.hebrew: בי אבא סוראה - חמיו היה, והשיא רב פפא לבנו אחות אשתו, כדאמרינן באלו נערות (לעיל כתובות לט:): אמרה לי בת אבא סוראה, כי נהמא אקושא בחינכי. ובסנהדרין (דף יד:) נמי אמרינן: איש ושתי נשים שאין מטילין לכיס אחד, כגון רב פפא ובת אבא סוראה:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:18:1.english: The family of Abba of Sura - He was [Rav Pappa's] father-in-law, and Rav Pappa married his wife's sister to his son, as we say in [the chapter entitled] Eilu Ne'arot (above, Ketubot 39b): "Abba of Sura's daughter told me: [It is] like hard bread on the gums." And in Sanhedrin (14b) as well, we say: a man and two women who do not deposit [their funds] into one purse, such as Rav Pappa and the daughter of Abba of Sura.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:18:2.hebrew: אזיל - רב פפא לבית אבי הנערה לכתוב כתובתה, ושם יפסוק אביה ויכתוב לה בנדונייתה מה שיכתוב:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:18:2.english: He went - Rav Pappa [went] to the house of the young woman's father to write her marriage contract, and there her father would stipulate and write for her in her dowry whatever he would write.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:18:3.english: When they came to the entrance - Of [the house of] Abba of Sura.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:18:4.english: He was taking his leave of him - Yehuda took permission from Rav Pappa to turn back.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:1:1.english: For the betterment of the world - So that [the captors] do not become accustomed to raising [the price] above their value.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:2:1.hebrew: כנגד כתובתה - אבל יותר מכתובתה לא, דלא יהא טפל חמור מן העיקר — תנאי כתובתה יתר על הכתובה:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:2:1.english: Equal to her marriage contract - But more than her marriage contract, [he does] not [have to redeem her], so that the secondary [obligation] not be more stringent than the primary [one] — [namely, that] a stipulation of her marriage contract [be] greater than the marriage contract [itself].

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:3:1.hebrew: תרי קולי - לא יותר על דמיה שהיא ראויה לימכר בשוק, ולא יותר על כתובתה:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:3:1.english: Two leniencies - [One does] not [pay] more than her value [for which] she is fit to be sold in the market, and not more than her ketubah.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:4:1.hebrew: וצריכה רפואה הרי היא כמזונות - ואם צריכה רפואה, הרי הרפואה כמזונות, דתרווייהו חיותא נינהו:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:4:1.english: And [she] requires medical treatment, it is like sustenance - And if she requires medical treatment, the medical treatment is like sustenance, for both of them are [essential for] life.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:4:2.hebrew: מזונות אין להם קצבה. הלכך, רפואה שיש לה קצבה — שאינה חולה תדיר — אינה בכלל מזונות:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:4:2.english: Sustenance has no fixed limit. Therefore, medical treatment that has a fixed limit — [meaning] she is not constantly ill — is not included in sustenance.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:5:1.english: Fix some [amount] for the doctor - That he should take upon himself her treatment permanently for such-and-such [a sum].

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:6:1.hebrew: כעורכי הדיינין - אוהב אחד מבעלי דינין, ומטעים זכיותיו לדיין, ועורך [הדין לפני] הדיינין לזכותו — מיקרי עורכי הדיינין, שעורך את הדיינין להפוך לבם לטובתו של זה:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:6:1.english: Like arrangers of the judges - [One who] favors one of the litigants, and presents his merits persuasively to the judge, and arranges [the case before] the judges to rule in his favor — is called "arrangers of the judges," for he arranges the judges to turn their hearts to the benefit of this one.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:6:2.english: At the outset - When he offered advice.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:7:1.hebrew: יתר על חולקהון דעם אחוהון - בני אשה אחרת. אם תמותי בחיי ואירשך, יטלו בניך כתובתיך. ונפקא מינה: שמא מרובה היא, או שמא יהו בני אשה האחרת מרובים ובניך מועטים, וטוב להן שיטלו כתובת אמן, והמרובים כתובת אמן, ואפי' הכתובות שוות:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:7:1.english: In addition to their portion with their brothers - [This refers to] the sons of another wife. If you die during my lifetime and I inherit you, your sons will take your ketubah. And the practical difference is: perhaps it [your ketubah] is larger, or perhaps the sons of the other wife will be many and your sons few, so it is better for them that they take their mother's ketubah and the many [take] their mother's ketubah, even if the ketubot are equal.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:8:1.english: All the days of the dwelling of your widowhood - [Meaning,] all the days of the duration of your widowhood.

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:9:1.hebrew: מפני מה תקנו כתובת בנין דכרין - מאחר שהבעל יורש את אשתו, למה תקנו שיוריש לבניה מה שירש ממנה, דהיינו נדוניא שלה:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:9:1.english: For what reason did they enact the ketubah of male children - Since the husband inherits his wife, why did they enact that he should bequeath to her sons what he inherited from her, that is, her dowry?

Rashi on Ketubot 52b:9:2.hebrew: ויתן לבתו - נדוניא יפה, דאילו מתה יירשו בניה:
Rashi on Ketubot 52b:9:2.english: And give to his daughter - a generous dowry, for if she dies, her sons will inherit [it].

Tosafot on Ketubot 52b:16:1.hebrew: ותגבה ממטלטלי ככתובה שויוה רבנן - והשתא שתקנו הגאונים שכתובה גובה ממטלטלי, כתובת בנין דכרין נמי גביא ממטלטלי, דהא ככתובה שויוה רבנן:
Tosafot on Ketubot 52b:16:1.english: "And let [it] be collected from movable property; the Sages established it as similar to a ketubah" - And now that the Geonim enacted that a ketubah is collected from movable property, the ketubah of male children [ketubbat benin dikhrin] is also collected from movable property, since the Sages established it as similar to a ketubah.

Tosafot on Ketubot 52b:17:1.hebrew: תטרוף ממשעבדי ירתון תנן - אף על פי שידע גם המקשה דירתון תנן, אלא שבלשון קצר משיבו; ור"ל דחכמים לא רצו לתת להם אלא דין ירושה, כיון דמכח ירושה קאתו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 52b:17:1.english: "Let it be collected from liened [property]." "We learned: 'Will inherit'" - Even though the questioner also knew that we learned "will inherit," [the Gemara] rather answers him in concise language; and it means to say that the Sages only wanted to give them the law of inheritance, since they come by virtue of inheritance.

Tosafot on Ketubot 52b:17:2.hebrew: ירתון תנן - גבי בת בין הבנים, לא בעי לשנויי בהא לישנא דירתון תנן, דאפילו למ"ד [יסבון] תנן מודה דלגבי הכי כנחלה שויוה רבנן, כדמוכח ביש נוחלין (ב"ב דף קלא.); אבל לגבי ממשעבדי איכא פלוגתא בינייהו, כדאמר התם ובריש אע"פ (לקמן כתובות דף נה.):
Tosafot on Ketubot 52b:17:2.english: "We learned: Yirtun [they will inherit]" - Regarding a daughter among the sons, [the Gemara] did not wish to answer with this formulation of "we learned yirtun," because even according to the one who says we learned [yisbun, "they will take"], he agrees that with respect to this [matter] the Sages treated it like an inheritance, as is proven in [the chapter] Yesh Nochalin (Bava Batra 131a); however, with respect to [collecting] from liened [property], there is a dispute between them, as [the Gemara] states there and at the beginning of [the chapter] Af Al Pi (below, Ketubot 55a).

Tosafot on Ketubot 52b:1:1.english: One does not redeem captives, etc. - [This] refers to the first clause [of the baraita].
